name: checklist-ok
description: Recorded 2026-10-29 with curl from POST https://sellmycompanydata.com/mcp (public, keyless; the request body is the one the connector sends; no headers kept). tools/call assessment_checklist. Response body verbatim.

content.text:
Privacy rule: Counts and date ranges only. Never read out, copy or send message text, customer or employee names, email addresses of other people, file contents or code to this server.
Rules:
- Inputs come from the user, or from figures the user has already asked you to gather. Do not guess a number.
- If you do not have a figure, ask the user for an approximate one and mark it as not measured.
- If chat volume is not available, ask the user. On paid Slack plans a workspace admin can see total messages in Slack's analytics dashboard.
- Tell the user which figures were measured and which are their estimates.
- Set measured to true only for numbers counted from the user's own systems at their request.
- Show the user the numbers you are about to send before you call estimate_data_value.
- Do not call request_offer unless the user asks for an offer and confirms their contact details.
What to measure:
- chat (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord): Years of history (oldest message year); Approximate message count; Share of public versus private channels; Number of active people.
- crm (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive): Number of contact, company and deal records; Years of history; Whether notes and activities are logged.
- support (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk): Number of tickets or conversations; Years of history.
- docs (Notion, Confluence, Google Drive, SharePoint): Approximate page or document count; Oldest document year.
- code (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket): Number of repositories; Years of commit history.
- email (Gmail, Outlook shared mailboxes): Approximate message count for shared or company mailboxes; Oldest message year.
- project (Jira, Asana, Linear, Monday): Number of tasks or issues; Years of history.
- finance (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, other ERP): Years of records; Approximate transaction or invoice count.
Company facts to collect: Approximate number of staff; Year the company was founded; Country: us, ca, uk, eu, anz or other.
Next: call estimate_data_value with the numbers.
